title: 맛있다
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. Acoustic guitar fingerpicks a steady eighth-note pattern with prominent string noise and fret slides. A baritone male vocal performs a melodic, breathy delivery in the lower register. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the dry, close-mic'd guitar and the centered vocal. Tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. Key is G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar with fret slides]

[Verse 1]
[breathy baritone male vocals]
가을이 벤치를 덮고 있었어
네가 앉던 자리에 낙엽이 쌓여
바람이 한 번 스치면 빈자리가
넓어지는 걸

커피가 식어가는 속도로
네 이름도 흐려지겠지
손끝에 나무결이 닿을 때
